trigger_condition: staffing_change_pct > 10 AND wait_time_baseline is not null
classification_logic: If staffing increase > 10% and wait time baseline exists flag possible wait-time reduction displacement
If absenteeism reduction > 15% and coverage < 90% flag possible staffing pressure displacement
If arrival increase > 10% and coverage < 90% flag possible staffing pressure displacement
If temporary staff added but uncovered shifts unchanged flag possible internal displacement
If replacement coverage < 50% and reduction > 10% flag possible internal displacement
If interaction factor != 1.0 flag possible combined displacement
